notes.title: February Update ~ Some Featured (New) Features
notes.content:
[h3]Hello gardeners,[/h3]

It’s still Winter, still cold. But work on The Garden Path hasn’t been hampered by the chill here in the UK. On the contrary, work has been in full force and I am pleased with the place it’s in right now.

Let’s head into the update to see what’s new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/455e12cc02e573c444fc5d20d90dcd5e21999cb0.png[/img]

[h3]Featured features[/h3]

With new content being implemented behind the scenes, The Garden Path has a whole host of new features to mention

Furnishings for the garden can now be layered, allowing you to hang smaller items on trees or place them on tables or cabinets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/c21d377e9d000d7b1f5d9ba93bd4f56e82d4a06b.jpg[/img]

Many new plants and flora have also been added to the game, including marigolds, pansies, daffodils, chrysanths - but you’ll need to find the seeds to plant them!

The movement system has seen some updates, including the base speed for the character increasing, increased base stamina, and faster sprint speeds, which should help you get to where you want to go in good time. A new sprint animation has also been added, so you can really feel the wind in your hair.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/e2e2a150ce7ee621b5d08aecadf92b322679649c.gif[/img]

The new pathfinding system has been introduced to the game, which will eventually allow characters to traverse more intelligently across the map, but for now should provide shorter loading times ~ something we’re working on whittling down further.

The game has been moved over to GLES3, which should provide better performance on newer systems, especially in areas with many lights.

Tents have made a triumphant return. They’re now easier to place, and no longer require a loading screen to enter or exit, simply walk up to the tent, unzip the door and you’re in. A great way to start your corner of the Garden.

[h3]A Little Bit of Fun[/h3]

Something our Community Manager, Alex, has been working on lately was a little personality quiz based on some of the animal travellers you might find in The Garden Path, and now you can give it a go.

It’s short and sweet but great fun. I spent too much time answering the questions myself!
Find out which character you are [url=https://www.opinionstage.com/alex-dewing/personality-25-Nov-21_09-19-13]here[/url], and be sure to share your results in our Discord server or in the comments.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/2eda58f874dd98b9d537a7bcb06f259a2bed404d.png[/img]
 
Until next time…
Louis, carrotcake

notes.title: January Update ~ A Retrospective 💫
notes.content:
[h3]Hello gardeners,[/h3]

2021 was a pivotal year for The Garden Path, and surely one to remember. From officially announcing the game, to launching a Kickstarter; growing a team, to releasing new builds – it’s been as daunting as it has been exciting.

While it hasn’t yet been a full year since the game was officially announced, it is only fitting that we celebrate how far we came in 2021 as we see in the new year.

[h3]A retrospective[/h3]

Perhaps the best marker for how far the game has come over the last 12 months is going back to watch the game’s ‘Flash Talk’ for the 2021 digital Godotcon, which aired close to a year ago today. The game really was hanging on by a thread at the time, and to see how much has changed visually and mechanically is hopefully a good sign for what we can achieve in 2022.

Following that, spring was a busy and exciting time for The Garden Path (which might be fitting for a game about gardening).

On May 26th the game held its official press announcement and was met with an incredibly humbling response. I couldn’t have asked for a warmer reaction.

Nearing the end of Spring, The Garden Path was lucky enough to be featured in the Wholesome Direct Showcase as part of E3 2021. It was surreal seeing the game being played alongside a whole host of great games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/9152c6cf8d366f1bae5a4b829b4e5100b1dc9467.jpg[/img]

After some long talks and some trepidation, we launched our Kickstarter in the summer. It was a challenge that, when beginning work on the game, I never imagined I would undertake. It was good fun designing and drafting the rewards for each tier, which I hope helped capture some imaginations along the way. 

The game’s time on Kickstarter came to a close at 152% funding with an amazing £30,474 pledged – a feat that could only have been achieved thanks to the trust and support of the game’s backers and followers who did so much in lifting the game to the finish line and beyond.

Thanks to everyone who supported the game, that extra 52% helped us to hit both of our stretch goals and is now helping us to bring The Garden Path to Nintendo Switch and multiplayer.

The demo from the Kickstarter, and later for the Steam Next Fest in October, proved to be invaluable as sources of feedback for the game, and where things could improve moving forward.

Following that feedback, many things were reworked, rewired, rewritten, to make the game better to play as well as more accessible. In early December, Kickstarter backers got access to the beta version.

We’ve still got a little way to go from here, but let’s take a look at the work that’s already been going on over and under the hood since the beta’s release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/e75c1ff95ff9ca83344bd8ef856c9497431684f6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Game Updates[/h3]

Thanks to the help of willing backers, there's been a real effort already in testing the game, finding bugs, and fixing them on the community discord. If you were a backer that opted for the itch.io version and would like to join in, hop on over to our [url=https://discord.gg/nWTg5WvZbU]Discord[/url].

Many dozens of bugs, from quirks to crashes, have already been fixed since then, but I've also been focusing on providing new features and tweaks to hopefully make the game better to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/9152c6cf8d366f1bae5a4b829b4e5100b1dc9467.jpg[/img]

A big request from the start of the game's inception has been the availability of multiple saves, and we now have a rudimentary system in place to support them. You can hop between your different gardens from the main menu, and starting a new game will no longer overwrite your old work. Soon the system will receive more polish, allowing you to delete old Gardens you no longer want.

A big quality-of-life improvement was added in the form of 'Nearby Indicators', which now appear when an NPC is off-screen but close by. This makes finding that NPC you're looking for even easier, without the need to pause and search the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/843c0f8e2e1d235fedc7d9f8e75e0e31ed805364.jpg[/img]

The function of the player's map has also been given a redesign, now allowing you to sweep the map with a reticle rather than by the acre. Today I implemented pins which you can place across the map to aid you as a reminder. Soon the pins will be integrated into the Nearby Indicator system, making it even easier to find your way around the Garden.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/37253f70ad179ed883ebae8e553bfca839a1a8eb.jpg[/img]

In-the-works and soon-to-be-available is a big overhaul of the game's mapping-navigation system which will allow for better character movement and placement. Some NPCs that are currently on the bench rely on this new system so will be soon to make an appearance. It should also speed up the game's loading time by some margin.

[b]Development is back in full swing in 2022, and I’ll be sharing as much progress as I can along the way.[/b]

And there we go. Thank you so much to everyone who has followed and supported The Garden Path this year, I owe it to all of you for sharing this turbulent and exciting year with me.

Until next time…
  
Louis, carrotcake

notes.title: November Update ~ Itch codes, encyclopaedias, and more!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello gardeners,[/h2]

It's been a short while since we shared our last update with you, but it has without a doubt been one of the most productive months for The Garden Path. Development has been gung-ho, and I have some very exciting news to share with you regarding where we are with the game.

Let’s take a look at what’s new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/942f178ea579892c67c826e195152332f160262d.png[/img]

[h3]Game Updates[/h3]

Lots of attention has been spent on how you experience the garden day to day. The garden now forecasts the weather ahead of time, as well as who will be visiting your garden. On each new day, you’ll now be greeted with an overview of information to help keep you in the loop. 

Some characters will let you know what time of day they will be stopping by, and might even dib on other character’s plans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/c44f6fc6dbef8f23967128388194af2e07a0eee9.jpg[/img]

The encyclopedia tab is now open for business, helping fill you in on what you've discovered across the garden, and what targets you need to meet to attract certain residents. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/7251b06538a210eef6f9742b6dde7094525bc173.jpg[/img]

The errand system has been revamped to allow for more complex errands, as well as supporting multiple errands from individual characters. More errands have been added to keep you busy, and help learn more about the characters and the history of the Garden.

Plenty of new garden furnishings have been added too, including pathing, fencing, and you can now combine certain furnishings too - like placing smaller objects on tables, or hanging items from tree branches.


[h3]Finally…some odds and ends[/h3]

A gentle reminder that there is an exclusive Kickstarter category on our official Discord Community server, which you can join [b][url=https://discord.gg/nWTg5WvZbU]here[/url][/b].

This is a great space to ask any questions you may have about the Kickstarter or the surveys that all backers should have now received, as well as to chat to the team, meet fellow backers, and help me in shaping The Garden Path.

If you backed The Garden Path and want to gain access to the Kickstarter space, be sure to join our server and make sure you’ve sent your Discord ID in with your backer survey. Your backer role will be added then, and you’ll be in!

I also wanted to highlight our TikTok, run by our own Community Manager: Alex. The account is a lot of fun and it’s a great way to keep up to date with The Garden Path. 

You can get to know some of the characters, see some sneak peeks into the game, and of course, have a good laugh. There are many bad puns to be found... 

If this is something you’d be interested in checking out then you can give us a follow [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fromcarrotcake?lang=en]here[/url][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/506a7492f336f8691b3d9f0898147afb717e8103.jpg[/img]

And that’s that. Stick around for more updates on The Garden Path soon!

Until next time…

~Louis

notes.title: (A Late) October Update ~ Rewards, game updates, and more!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello gardeners,[/h3]

Happy late Halloween and Bonfire Night everyone! October was an interesting month for The Garden Path, with a great deal of work going on behind the scenes (some of which is very exciting and you’ll be finding out about [i]very soon[/i]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/455e12cc02e573c444fc5d20d90dcd5e21999cb0.png[/img]
  
[h3]#TGPtober was a Cozy Hit[/h3]

Our take on the Autumn Inktober Tradition was a lovely constant throughout October. I had a great time coming up with ideas and illustrations for each new prompt, and it was even better seeing your own designs inspired by the challenge.

I’ve been so impressed by the creativity and love that people have put into this project - from creating charming original characters to trying out new styles and techniques.

While we can’t show off every piece that was created as a part of #TGPtober, [b]we did want to highlight a few of our favourites[/b]. Thank you again for taking part in this challenge with me, I hope we’ll have the opportunity for similar events in the future.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/f907286c4b48810e947158576d68be65530aec55.png[/img]

8. Priscilla’s Original Vegetable-Headed Character: Laurel - @crystalunvrs, on Twitter
9. Blind Luck’s Egret Orchid - @blinded_luck, on Instagram

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/4ad3cc76ba707c36ed8c85045c8f52fc57ba4ea4.png[/img]
 
[h3]Some bits and bobs[/h3]

Don’t forget, we have an [b]exclusive Kickstarter category on our official Discord Community server[/b], which you can join [url=https://t.co/fqTDcmZAyb?amp=1][b]here[/b][/url]. This is a dedicated space where you can ask us questions about the Kickstarter, chat with fellow backers, and help me in shaping The Garden Path with your feedback and ideas.

If you backed The Garden Path and want to gain access to the Kickstarter space, be sure to [b]join our server and make sure you’ve sent your Discord ID in with your backer survey[/b]. Your backer role will be added then!

Work on the physical and digital rewards continues to take place behind the scenes, but we wanted to give you a sneak peek of the special reward for The Collectors - the handcrafted ceramic figurines of some of the garden’s residents. I think they’re looking rather charming... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/190894d5c64aefcba2f6ea1aa8ff4cf9ef32a187.jpg[/img]
 
In last month’s update I spoke a little about how The Garden Path team is expanding, thanks to the generosity of our supporters. I’m pleased to say that not only did we recently bring on Megan as our new Environment Designer, but also that we recently closed applications for a Contract Developer, who will be coming on board to help develop the local multiplayer systems unlocked in our Kickstarter stretch goals.

I feel very fortunate to be in the position to recruit new collaborators to work within bringing The Garden Path to life. I hope this will allow us to create the best version of the game, while making sure that everyone can maintain a good work/life balance.

[h3]Some Game Updates[/h3]

With all the great feedback from the demos, there's been lots more work than anticipated on my plate to update fundamentals on how the game works, plays and feels.

[b]Menus have been simplified and consolidated[/b], and a new contextual control system streamlines how you interact with the Garden, no longer requiring you to equip each tool you wish to use. A new, optional tutorial helps show you the ropes before you start playing so that newer players don't feel overwhelmed.

There have also been [b]updates to the physics of how the player moves[/b] to hopefully be more brisk and responsive, as well as improvements to the camera. I've also completely [b]rebuilt how the game delivers ambient noises[/b], like wind and birdsong, so it feels as though it's moving around you as you travel the Garden. Night-time audio has received attention too, for those who found the crickets to be irritating at best.
 
The new-game menu has been rewritten too, with some more options, and now [b]more than 20 skin tones to choose from[/b] (up from the previous three).

I hope it will be worth the extra wait, I'm really happy with the way it's shaping up.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/e7e303098a21d20414b656ae92aead0d69635a07.png[/img]
 
And that’s all folks. Stick around for more updates on The Garden Path soon!

Until next time…

~Louis

notes.title: Steam Next Fest, October Art Challenge and more!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello gardeners,[/h3]

The months and seasons are turning, and big updates for The Garden Path are on the horizon. September has been a busy month for myself and the team (which I’ll touch on in a moment), and October isn’t showing any signs of slowing down. There's a lot in store and I'm eager to hear what you think, so let's jump right in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/6f25fad8ee22001b33fdbdb9167ad3838703045c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Join me in #TGPtober[/h3]

Inktober is an Autumn tradition that I've been fond of since first tackling it in 2018. Last year, I took a turn from the traditional prompts and illustrated a new vegetable headed resident every day throughout the month.

Ever since The Garden Path community began to form, I've noted just how many creatives we have with us - from artists, to writers, figurine creators to book makers. So this year, I thought a fun way to build off last year's Inktober is to share a 'The Garden Path'-themed list of prompts for anyone to join in.

#TGPtober is therefore designed to encompass any type of creative form, whether you want to paint, draw, photograph, write, sculpt or anything else that comes to mind. After all, this challenge is all about how you interpret these prompts.

The prompts are bi-weekly as opposed to daily, a decision which will hopefully give you more time to join in and create alongside the prompts that suit you.

If you want to get involved, make sure to share your work with the hashtag #TGPtober. Alternatively, if you’re not comfortable posting your pieces on Twitter or Instagram then consider joining our Discord community and sharing your process there. Wherever you share your work, it might even end up in a #TGPtober gallery…!

I’ll be getting involved myself and I cannot wait to get started and to see what you come up with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/d3932a4af3f39b1a32c36e23987669a464e176a5.jpg[/img]
 
[h3]We’re going to Steam Next Fest[/h3]

[i]“Seven days, hundreds of new demos, oodles of livestreams.”[/i]

Steam Next Fest is a multi-day celebration of upcoming games taking place from the 1st to the 7th of October, and I am thrilled to announce that The Garden Path is going to be taking part.

You’ll be able to get your hands on our demo, fresh with some new updates to make your gameplay experience as smooth and soothing as possible.

If you've enjoyed the demo before you'll be glad to know lots of hard-work on the full game is finding its way onto the next demo for testing.

Perhaps the biggest addition will be auto-saving! While I've been hard at work eliminating crashes, hiccups happen to the best of us, but now you can help test jumping right back in where you left off.

Just note that the demo is the first day of the garden, and will reset when a new day dawns.

I will also be taking part in a couple of special livestreams alongside The Garden Path’s community manager, Alex. We’ll be showcasing the demo and answering any questions you may have about the game. 

So, be sure to come and say hi ~ you’ll be able to join us on:

[h3][b]Saturday the 2nd of October from 8am PDT / 11am EDT / 4pm BST / 5pm CEST[/b] and then on [b]Tuesday the 5th from 9am PDT / 12pm EDT / 5pm BST / 6pm CEST![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/1770506d0f2f3f5e2fa08fc50188e714f5e21fa4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Finally… some bits and pieces[/h3]

You may have seen that I've recently been recruiting some help - and that is all possible thanks to the generosity of our supporters and community. 

I’ve been able to start recruiting help from collaborators so that we can reach the full vision I have for The Garden Path, all while hopefully ensuring some good work/life balance for all.

As of writing this, the applications for Environment Designer have now closed, but do keep an eye open, as I’m sure we’ll be announcing a new position very soon. This isn’t the only position joining me on The Garden Path, but for now mum’s the word. 

As for game development, in addition to the autosave function I’ve been working on, the garden itself has seen some polish and landscaping ~ with updated water, cliffs, and even more variety of plants to discover.

Mouse controls are now fleshed out and ready to play with, making the game more accessible and comfortable for those who prefer to play with mouse and keyboard.

Not to mention many more small fixes, polishes and tweaks all thanks for the invaluable feedback the community has provided.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/4d504b4c86fb2e9d2818b8fbc4eb37651c83484d.gif[/img]

And that’s all folks. Stick around for more updates on The Garden Path soon!

Until next time…
Louis, carrotcake

Hi all, just pushed this latest version which expands mouse support across the game, as well as other bug fixes and stability tunings.

+ Player movement can now be made with the mouse by left clicking and dragging in the direction you want to move. Actions can be made by right clicking
+ New 'Dash' UI element allows opening other UI elements with the mouse, and also provides control reminders.
+ Character dialogue now supports mouse controls.
+ Most system menus and options now support mouse control.
+ Various camera tunes.
+ Inventory stability fixes.
+ Fixed item duplicate/deletion bug when trading with items in  the overflow.

Note that the new game screen, stars and quantity selector are yet to support mouse controls.

Thanks as always for your feedback and support.

~Louis

notes.title: See You at the Future Games Show!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello gardeners,[/h3]

What a tumultuous couple of weeks we've had.

It's hard to believe the Kickstarter campaign is wrapped up and behind us - but thanks to the earnest support of every backer and follower, there's now plenty more to come.

In case you missed it, during our 30 days on Kickstarter we not only hit full funding but also both of our stretch goals! 

And so The Garden Path will be both coming to [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] and will offer [b]Local Multiplayer[/b].

[b]Overall 1,097 backers pledged £30,474 to help this game blossom. 

It's an incredible achievement that wouldn't have been possible without you, whether or not you were in a position to back the game, you have my thanks.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/e75c1ff95ff9ca83344bd8ef856c9497431684f6.jpg[/img]
[h3]See You at the Future Games Show![/h3]

As the title of this update suggests, I am happy to announce that The Garden Path will be featured in The Future Games Show at this year's Gamescom!

With the show back online this year, GamesRadar presents The Future Games Show will be taking place [b]TODAY[/b] (Thursday, August 26) at [b]13:00 PDT / 16:00 EDT / 21:00 BST / 22:00 CEST[/b].

I can't wait to share The Garden Path to a new audience and, hopefully, I'll see you there.

Tune in tonight at [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/gamesradar]twitch.tv/gamesradar[/url] ~ [url=youtube.com/GamesRadar]youtube.com/GamesRadar[/url] ~ [url=twitter.com/GamesRadar]twitter.com/GamesRadar[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/7df8e3286457941bd10b7bcc7e0a7cfe6bb764dd.png[/img]

[h3]And Finally...Some Demo News
[/h3]
While the Kickstarter is over, the demo continues to live on.

In fact, you'll even be able to access the demo via Steam from the 26th of August. 

This will help us get The Garden Path to as many people as possible and will give you a whole new toolset in experiencing the game. You'll be able to share screenshots, chat in the community hub, and more. 

So, keep your eyes open for that, and be sure to share your gardening journey! 

Thank you again for your support for The Garden Path.

If you haven't yet, please consider giving The Garden Path a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638500/The_Garden_Path/]wishlist[/url] and a follow ~ adding it to your Steam Wishlist is an easy, quick, and incredibly valuable way to help indie developers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638500/The_Garden_Path

Until next time…

notes.title: 2 Weeks on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Welcome back!

I am happy to announce that, just two weeks since we launched, we have passed [b]75% funding[/b] on Kickstarter!

I wanted to thank you once again - to be at this point in the project and already so close to hitting that main goal is endlessly encouraging, and wouldn't be possible without the support of each and every wishlishter, backer, and supporter. 

Please continue to spread the word about The Garden Path if you can! It remains one of the best ways to bring more people to the game, especially now when we're on that home stretch for the main goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/e1c8e1bbf566445d50a5253097858efe2fa915a3.gif[/img]

You can find and follow the Kickstarter with the link below:

[h3][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fromcarrotcake/the-garden-path-a-hand-illustrated-slice-of-life-sim-game]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fromcarrotcake/the-garden-path-a-hand-illustrated-slice-of-life-sim-game[/url][/h3]

You can see how the project is doing and which rewards are still available - but I must report that the one-of-a-kind ceramic models kindly being crafted by my Mum are now all gone! 

I’ve already updated the demo a handful of times with fixes over the past two weeks, many of which I’ve been able to find and debug thanks to your help sharing notes on the Discord.

If you’ve had a chance to play the demo, thank you - I really appreciate you checking it out and hope you enjoyed your time in The Garden. And if you haven’t played the demo yet, there's still plenty of time to download and give it a try.

Either way, if you have any thoughts or questions, be sure to send them my way.

If you haven't yet joined our Discord community and want to share your experience with the demo or just say hi then find us here: 

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/nWTg5WvZbU]https://discord.gg/nWTg5WvZbU[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/6f25fad8ee22001b33fdbdb9167ad3838703045c.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for reading, sharing and supporting The Garden Path.

Whether you've been able to back the game or not, I hope you'll join me on this last stretch ~ To 100%!

Until next time…

notes.title: LIVE on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Welcome back to the Steam community and, yes, [b][i]The Garden Path is live on Kickstarter now![/i][/b]

As mentioned in my last update, there's been a tremendous amount of work behind the scenes setting this all up, so I hope you enjoy everything we have to show!

If all goes well, this campaign will be a big step in eventually bringing  The Garden Path to new platforms and new places, allowing even more folk to enjoy and experience the game.

Should the opportunity arise, your support will also go to making sure everything runs as smoothly as possible, and give it that extra layer of polish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610797/aa940a9488ec20ab61061c59c70292cd291cccd4.png[/img]

You can find and follow the Kickstarter with the link below:

[h3][i][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fromcarrotcake/the-garden-path-a-hand-illustrated-slice-of-life-sim-game]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fromcarrotcake/the-garden-path[/url][/b][/i][/h3]

Here you can read about the campaign’s story, learn more about how your support will help, and back The Garden Path should you wish.

There are some neat rewards on offer, from prints and pins - and I've even got my Mum working her magic on one-of-a-kind ceramic models that you can pick up.

Perhaps even bigger news -- you can now begin to uncover the garden and meet some residents in an early test demo, available to play right now!

It's a snapshot of what's available in the game, but hopefully it will give a feeling of what's yet to come, and you can always share your experiences, thoughts, or report any bugs in The Garden Path discord ~ I'll be there responding to as many as I can.

https://discord.gg/nWTg5WvZbU

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40610797/4d504b4c86fb2e9d2818b8fbc4eb37651c83484d.gif[/img]

Thank you for reading and for supporting The Garden Path! 
Whether or not you’re in a position to back the game on Kickstarter, your engagement and excitement alone are always hugely appreciated. 

Expect more updates (and Kickstarter news) to come!

Until then...
